# Parse the read_result to identify confirmed orders
import re

lines = read_result.strip().split('\n')

cells = {}

    if m:
        row, col, val = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3)
        cells[(row, col)] = val

# Headers are in row 1

    if cells.get((row, 7)) == 'Confirmed':
        confirmed_rows.append(row)

print(confirmed_orders_summary)
print(f"Headers: {headers}")

# Step 1: Create the new Excel file

header_labels = ["Order ID", "Customer", "Product", "Quantity", "Unit Price", "Total", "Status", "Date"]
cmds = []
for col_idx, label in enumerate(header_labels, 1):
    cmd = f"python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/excel/set_cell.py --file_path /workspace/testbed/data/confirmed_orders.xlsx --row_idx 1 --column_idx {col_idx} --text '{label}'"
    cmds.append(cmd)

# Write all headers

    await run_command(cmd)

print("Headers written successfully")

import re

    m = re.match(r'\((\d+), (\d+)\): (.+)', line)
    if m:
        row, col, val = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3)
        cells[(row, col)] = val

confirmed_src_rows = []
for row in range(2, 22):
    if cells.get((row, 7)) == 'Confirmed':
        confirmed_src_rows.append(row)

dest_row = 2
for src_row in confirmed_src_rows:
    for col in range(1, 9):
        val = cells.get((src_row, col), '')
        # Escape single quotes in values
        val_escaped = val.replace("'", "'\\''")
        cmd = f"python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/excel/set_cell.py --file_path /workspace/testbed/data/confirmed_orders.xlsx --row_idx {dest_row} --column_idx {col} --text '{val_escaped}'"
        await run_command(cmd)
    dest_row += 1

print(f"Wrote {len(confirmed_src_rows)} confirmed orders (rows 2-{dest_row-1}) to confirmed_orders.xlsx")

# QA: Read back the new file to verify
